page_title: STU 2-0 PAU | Stuttgart v St. Pauli 19/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Substitution. Jamie Leweling makes his way off the pitch and Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as his replacement.
90+2' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) replacing Chema Andres.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) commits a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Here comes a substitution. Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) is brought on as a substitute for Ermedin Demirovic.
84' Maximilian Mittelstadt will be replaced by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
84' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Arkadiusz Pyrka (St. Pauli) replaces Manolis Saliakas.
84' Substitution. Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) replaces Adam Dzwigala.
81' The resulting corner from Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is cleared.
79' Shots on target – 5:2.

75' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
74' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
74' Alexander Blessin is forced to make a change. Danel Sinani is unable to continue due to injury, Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) comes on.
73' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) picks up an injury.
73' Here's the change. Tiago Tomas leaves the pitch and Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.

71' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Alexander Nubel to get hold of the ball.
68' St. Pauli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
62' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage will be replaced by Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli).
62' Andreas Hountondji comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli).
58' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
58' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
56' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Nikola Vasilj.
55' A dangerous looking corner kick from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is cleared to safety by the defence.

54' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Alexander Nubel makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! St. Pauli earn a corner.
53' Good movement by Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
52' OFF THE BAR! Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
50' 2 - 0 Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Sascha Stegemann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but Nikola Vasilj punches the ball away.
43' 1 - 0 Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
40' James Sands (St. Pauli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
38' A pass by Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Stuttgart have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
35' The corner kick from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

32' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) gets inside the box and tries to beat Nikola Vasilj with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
29' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
29' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.
24' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Nikola Vasilj who easily stops the effort.
24' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is going to take the penalty!
24' A player from St. Pauli pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. PENALTY to Stuttgart! Let's see who will take responsibility.
22' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
18' A pass from Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) is intercepted by Alexander Nubel and the move breaks down.
16' Stuttgart are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.

14' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
11' Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
5' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) has a goal ruled out for offside!
3' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
2' Adam Dzwigala (St. Pauli) was too forceful with his tackle and Sascha Stegemann interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
